mapper.select: SELECT user_id, points, status, del_flag FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_credit_account (account_id, user_id, account_scope, currency_code, opening_balance, balance, version, last_entry_sequence, last_entry_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userId}, #{accountScope}, #{currencyCode}, #{openingBalance}, #{balance}, #{version}, #{lastEntrySequence}, #{lastEntryHash}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO fbs_credit_operation (operation_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, account_id, user_id, account_scope, currency_code, operation_type, delta_amount, reason_code, reason_note, actor_user_id, reversal_of_operation_id, balance_before, balance_after, created_at) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{accountId}, #{userId}, #{accountScope}, #{currencyCode}, #{operationType}, #{delta}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonNote}, #{actorUserId}, #{reversalOfOperationId}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fbs_credit_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM fbs_credit_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM fbs_credit_operation WHERE reversal_of_operation_id = #{operationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, entry_id, operation_id, request_digest, account_id, sequence_no, delta_amount, balance_before, balance_after, previous_entry_hash, entry_hash, created_at FROM fbs_credit_entry WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.sequence_no = #{fromSequence} THEN 1 WHEN p.sequence_no = e.sequence_no - 1 AND BINARY e.previous_entry_hash = BINARY p.entry_hash AND e.balance_before = p.balance_after THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS valid_transition_count, MIN(e.sequence_no) AS min_sequence, MAX(e.sequence_no) AS max_sequence, MAX(CASE WHEN e.sequence_no = #{toSequence} THEN e.entry_hash ELSE NULL END) AS head_hash, MAX(CASE WHEN e.sequence_no = #{toSequence} THEN e.balance_after ELSE NULL END) AS head_balance FROM fbs_credit_entry e LEFT JOIN fbs_credit_entry p ON p.account_id = e.account_id AND p.sequence_no = e.sequence_no - 1 WHERE e.account_id = #{accountId} AND BINARY e.account_id = BINARY #{accountId} AND e.sequence_no BETWEEN #{fromSequence} AND #{toSequence} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_credit_entry (entry_id, operation_id, request_digest, account_id, sequence_no, delta_amount, balance_before, balance_after, previous_entry_hash, entry_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{entryId}, #{operationId}, #{requestDigest}, #{accountId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{delta}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{previousEntryHash}, #{entryHash}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.operation_id, e.entry_id, o.idempotency_key, o.request_digest, o.account_id, o.user_id, o.account_scope, o.currency_code, o.operation_type, o.delta_amount, o.reason_code, o.reason_note, o.actor_user_id, o.reversal_of_operation_id, o.balance_before, o.balance_after, e.sequence_no, e.previous_entry_hash, e.entry_hash, o.created_at, e.request_digest AS entry_request_digest, e.account_id AS entry_account_id, e.delta_amount AS entry_delta_amount, e.balance_before AS entry_balance_before, e.balance_after AS entry_balance_after, e.created_at AS entry_created_at, original.operation_type AS original_operation_type, original.account_id AS original_account_id, original.user_id AS original_user_id, original.delta_amount AS original_delta_amount FROM fbs_credit_operation o INNER JOIN fbs_credit_entry e ON e.operation_id = o.operation_id LEFT JOIN fbs_credit_operation original ON original.operation_id = o.reversal_of_operation_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY e.sequence_no DESC LIMIT 101
